subject: general
question: The Ministry of Minority Affairs launched the Skilling and Women Entrepreneurship Development project at the Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT) Kottayam in July 2025 to train minority youth and women in which of the following fields?

options.text: Internet of Things (IoT) and leadership skills

solution:
The correct answer is __**Internet of Things (IoT) and leadership skills**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ministry of Minority Affairs** initiated the **Skilling and Women Entrepreneurship Development** project in **July 2025**. This project serves as a strategic intervention to bridge the digital and skill gap among marginalized sections of society.
 
• The project is hosted and executed at the **Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT) Kottayam**, an institution of national importance located in **Kerala**. The collaboration aims to utilize the technical infrastructure and academic excellence of the institute.
 
• The curriculum specifically focuses on **Internet of Things (IoT)** training, enabling participants to understand and build connected systems, which is a critical component of **Industry 4.0**.
 
• A unique feature of this project is the integration of **leadership skills** alongside technical modules. This dual approach ensures that **minority youth** and **women** are not just prepared for jobs but are also equipped to start their own ventures as **entrepreneurs**.
 
• The project targets the socio-economic empowerment of the **minority communities**, focusing on increasing their participation in the high-tech workforce and the **startup ecosystem**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Minority Affairs:** 
 
 
• Established in **January 2006**, this ministry focuses on the development and empowerment of notified minority communities, including **Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Parsis,** and **Jains**.
 
• It implements various schemes such as **Naya Savera**, **Nai Roshni**, and **Seekho aur Kamao** to enhance educational and professional opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Internet of Things (IoT):** 
 
 
• **IoT** refers to a network of physical objects embedded with sensors, software, and other technologies to connect and exchange **data** with other devices over the internet.
 
• Applications of **IoT** span across **smart homes**, **healthcare**, **agriculture**, and **industrial automation**, making it a high-demand skill in the **2025** global economy.
 
 
 
• **IIIT Kottayam:** 
 
 
• Located at **Valavoor** in **Kottayam**, **Kerala**, it is one of the **IIITs** established by the **Government of India** under the **Public-Private Partnership (PPP)** mode.
 
• The institute offers specialized courses in **Computer Science**, **Cyber Security**, and **Data Science**, providing an ideal environment for advanced technical skilling projects.
 
 
 
• **Entrepreneurship and Leadership:** 
 
 
• The inclusion of **leadership skills** is aligned with the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020**, which emphasizes holistic development and vocational training.
 
• Developing **leadership skills** helps in decision-making, team management, and **strategic planning**, which are essential for the success of **women-led startups**.
 
 
 
• **Skill India Mission:** 
 
 
• This project contributes to the broader **Skill India Mission** launched in **2015**, aiming to create a workforce that can meet the challenges of the **global market** through continuous **upskilling** and **reskilling**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Gender Inclusivity:** The project prioritizes **women** to improve the **Female Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR)** in the technology sector.
 
• **Geographic Impact:** While located in **Kottayam**, the model is designed to be scalable, potentially serving as a blueprint for other **IIITs** across **India**.
 
• **Technological Advancement:** By focusing on **IoT**, the government ensures that **minority youth** are trained in **future-ready technologies** rather than traditional, low-value skills.
</ul
